snippet.title: Orebital Dynamics - Alpha Version Trailer
snippet.description:
#trailer  #indiegame #incrementalgame 
🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4895880/Orebital_Dynamics?utm_campaign=alpha_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_source=youtube&utm_content=alpha_trailer ⛏️

A tactile space‑mining incremental game where you command snake-like drills through grids of space rock. At Orebital Dynamics, your job is to mine rare resources and bring every drill home safely.

Play the game(on browser): https://brainoid.itch.io/orebital-dynamics
